    public static long[][] stirling;

        BufferedReader f = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(f.readLine());

        long m = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());

        stirling = new long[k+1][k+1];

                stirling[i][j] %= MOD;
            }

        long prob = 1;
        // Compute falling factorial separately
        long fall = 1;
        for(int i = 0; i < k; i++){
            fall = (fall * (n - i)) % MOD;
        }
        for(int i = k; i > 0; i--){
            prob = (prob * p) % MOD;
            ans = (ans + ((fall * prob) % MOD) * stirling[k][k-i+1]) % MOD;
            // Update fall for next iteration (remove largest factor)
            if(i > 1) fall = (fall * modInverse(n - (k - i), MOD)) % MOD;

        System.out.println(ans);

        return power(x, p-2, p);
    }

            y = y >> 1;
            x = (x * x) % p;

            t = x0;

        return (fact(n) * modInverse((fact(r) * fact(n-r)) % MOD, MOD)) % MOD;
    }

            y = y >> 1;
            x = (x * x) % p;

            for(int j = i; j >= 1; j--){

                stirling[i][j] %= MOD;
            }

        long prob = 1;
        for(int i = k; i > 0; i--){

            ans = (ans + ((val * prob) % MOD) * stirling[k][k-i+1]) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    // Recursive power
    public static long modInverse(long x, long p){
        return power(x, p-2, p);
    }

    public static long power(long x, long y, long p){
        if(y == 0) return 1;
        long half = power(x, y/2, p);
        half = (half * half) % p;
        if(y % 2 == 1) half = (half * x) % p;
        return half;
